paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.45% on average, with Nasdaq strongest (+1.11%) and Hang Seng weakest (-1.32%). Brent crude changed +1.72% to 111.43. Gold changed -0.49% to 4,139.7002. Bitcoin changed -0.53% to 81,421.7188. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.136%, a relative move of +0.75%. Among the firms tracked, Deutsche Bank (-2.89%) and Barclays (-2.72%) moved the most.
